text.en:
Targets killed by <solar/>Solar Supers <solar/>Ignite and spawn a <solar/>Firesprite at their location.

Deadshot Golden Gun refunds 1 ammo per kill.

Well of Radiance makes all Weapon Damage count as Super Ability Damage for the Caster. Solar Weapons Kills count as Solar Super Kills.

Targets killed by <solar/>Solar Supers <solar/>Ignite and spawn a <solar/>Firesprite at their location.

Deadshot Golden Gun refunds 1 ammo per kill.

Note: Well of Radiance makes all Weapon Damage count as Super Ability Damage for the Caster so Solar Weapons Kills will also count as Solar Super Kills.
